require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'sqlite3'
DB = SQLite3::Database.new('directory.db')
post '/search' do
  payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  tenant = payload.fetch('tenant')
  value = payload.fetch('value')
  columns = {'name' => 'name', 'email' => 'email'}
  field = columns[payload.fetch('field')]
  halt 400, 'invalid field' unless field
  rows = DB.execute("SELECT name, email FROM people WHERE tenant_id = ? AND #{field} = ?", [tenant, value])
  content_type :json
  JSON.generate(rows)
end
